ir.name: loss_stabilized_log_ratio_sigmoid_advantage_gap_mean_weighted
ir.intuition: Replaced the exponential scaling with a sigmoid clamp on advantage_gap to prevent numerical overflow and instability. The loss now computes a smooth sigmoid of the scaled log ratio, softly penalizing preference violations while ensuring numerical stability. Weighting is preserved and mean aggregation ensures smooth gradient flow. This simplification avoids the unbounded exponential scaling and stabilizes learning.
ir.pseudocode:
ratio = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scale_factor = sigmoid(clamp(advantage_gap, -10, 10))
scaled_ratio = ratio * scale_factor
loss = softplus(-scaled_ratio) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    ratio = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(adv_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    scale_factor = ops.sigmoid(adv_clamped)
    scaled_ratio = ops.mul(ratio, scale_factor)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(scaled_ratio))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
